IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR BIDDERS Please note the following crucial changes in DVC’s tender process. Non -compliance with any of the instructions may lead to rejection of the bi d. 1. Only Soft Copy of Integrity Pact is acceptable A pre-signed, soft copy of the Integrity Pact must be uploaded online. Hard c opies are not accepted. 2. Only e-Bank Guarantee (e-BG) or Insurance Surety Bond shall be a ccepted towards Earnest Money Deposit (EMD). No other mode of E MD submission is permissible and acceptable. 3. The tender is a Single Packet Bid. Any reference made anywhere to a “Two Packet Bid” shall be ignored. During bid evaluation, all responsive bidders shall be provisionally qualified on the GeM portal without detailed evaluation of techno-c ommercial and QR documents at the initial stage, and the price bids of all participating bidders shall be opened for preparation of the c omparative statement. The preliminary ranking of bidders shall be established solely on th e basis of the quoted price (L1, L2, L3, etc.) for each item, arranged

in ascending order of value. Thereafter, techno-commercial evaluation shall be carried out only for the L1 bidder. In case the techno-commercial documents of the prospective L1 bidder are found non-compliant with the NIT require ments, evaluation shall be taken up for the next lowest bidder (L2), and so on. This process shall continue until a bidder is identified who is both t he lowest priced among the remaining bidders and techno-commerc ially compliant. Such bidder shall be treated as the final L1 bidder. Bidders found non-compliant with NIT requirements, even if they h ave quoted prices lower than the finally accepted L1 bidder, shall b e disqualified after opening of the price bids. All applicable provisions of the MSME Policy, Make in India (MII) Policy, and other statutory norms of GOI shall be followed in line with the provisions of NIT. 4. Bid evaluation for the tender is on item wise basis. Bidder may qu ote for any single schedule or two schedules or three schedules or f or all schedules. The qualifying requirements for different combinat ions have been mentioned at Qualifying Requirement clause in VOL -III SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITION (STC), of the Buyer upload ed ATC document. 5. Post-bid clarifications are not allowed and entertained. No shortf all documents or additional clarifications will be sought after openi ng of bids. Bidders are therefore advised to carefully read the NIT and fill in Annexure-MD. 6. Notes on Performance Security / Security Deposit: · For contracts having a value above ₹1 crore, only e-Bank Guara ntee (e-BG) or Insurance Surety Bond shall be accepted towards Performance Security. · For contracts having a value up to ₹1 crore, Security Deposit shall be re covered through pro-rata deduction at the rate of 3% from each Running Account (RA) Bill, which will be released after the expiry of the Performa nce Guarantee period. . 2.
